rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: At the briefing of 11 December 2017 the Central Election Authority chairman said the last time for withdrawals had ended at 3 p.m. that day, that 89 nominations for Shri Rahul Gandhi were valid, and declared him elected President of the Indian National Congress.

rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The same briefing says the handing over of the Certificate of Election as Congress President was scheduled for 16 December 2017 at 11 a.m. on the lawns of the AICC office, 24 Akbar Road.

rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: In the same briefing the Central Election Authority chairman thanks the Hon'ble Congress President Smt. Sonia Gandhi and Vice President Shri Rahul Gandhi for their guidance.
